name: Clipping Magic
description_en:
Clipping Magic is a web background-removal tool with automatic clipping and a Smart Editor for correcting the foreground/background boundary. Red/green marks, a scalpel and edge/hair controls support manual correction; bulk workflows add queues and result downloads rather than eliminating review.

It fits product photos and other images needing transparent or replacement backgrounds. Upload/edit preview is available without commitment, but watermark removal and downloads require a subscription. Credits count downloaded images, with different treatment for re-downloads and duplicate uploads, so budget the workflow rather than just the number of preview edits.
description_zh:
Clipping Magic是网页去背景工具，自动抠图后可在Smart Editor修正前景/背景边界，提供红绿标记、手术刀及边缘/发丝控件；批量流程增加队列与结果下载，不取消人工检查。

它适合需要透明或替换背景的商品图等素材。上传/编辑预览无需承诺，去水印及下载需订阅。点数按下载图片计，重复下载和重复上传的处理不同，应按实际流程而非预览编辑次数预算。

sections.title_zh: 修边前先检查自动结果
sections.en:
The [Photo Basics tutorial](https://clippingmagic.com/tutorials/photo-basics) uploads a photo, produces an automatic result and then opens it for inspection. Zoom in and use red to remove unwanted background, green to restore missing foreground and the scalpel for difficult boundaries. Optional finishing controls include crop, color, background and shadow settings. These are image edits, not guaranteed compliance with a marketplace’s entire listing policy.

The marking semantics matter: every green-marked pixel is fully kept and every red-marked pixel fully removed; the algorithm decides unmarked areas. Use sparse marks wholly inside the intended region and do not let red and green touch. If a mark crosses the boundary, erase it or undo; Menu → Clear Marks can restart. A product handle or gap may require its own background mark. Do not paint the entire subject merely to make the algorithm work harder.
sections.zh:
[Photo Basics教程](https://clippingmagic.com/tutorials/photo-basics)上传照片后先出自动结果，再检查；放大后用红色移除多余背景、绿色恢复丢失前景，困难边界用手术刀。可再调整裁切、颜色、背景及阴影。这些是图片编辑，不保证符合某平台全部上架政策。

标记含义很重要：绿色像素全部保留，红色全部删除，未标记部分由算法判断。应稀疏标在目标区域内部，红绿不接触。标记跨边界就擦除或撤销，也可Menu → Clear Marks重来。商品把手/空隙可能需要独立背景标记，没必要涂满主体。

sections.title_en: A bulk job still has review and download states
sections.title_zh: 批量仍有审阅及下载状态
sections.en:
The [bulk tutorial](https://clippingmagic.com/tutorials/bulk-clipping) describes queued uploads, background preload of the next image and sequential review. Set defaults before starting: target crop size and Fit To Result help maintain framing, but inspect each subject. Marks can be copied/pasted for nearly identical subject/camera setups; Clear All removes that image’s marks/settings without clearing the clipboard. Reusing marks on unrelated images is not a safe default.

ZIP downloads contain batches of up to 50 images, with only one ZIP created at a time; simultaneous requests can contain the same images. Alternatively export a CSV containing result URLs, which expire after seven days. That is a temporary handoff list, not permanent hosted storage. Clip/Re-clip and Download/Re-download labels distinguish processing from download state. Upload bandwidth can degrade editing, so the guide suggests waiting for upload completion if necessary. No upload queue, ZIP or CSV was exercised.
sections.zh:
[批量教程](https://clippingmagic.com/tutorials/bulk-clipping)介绍排队上传、后台预载下一图及逐张检查。开始前先设默认目标裁切及Fit To Result以保持构图，但仍须看每个主体。近乎相同主体/机位可复制粘贴标记，Clear All只清该图标记/设置、不清剪贴板；不能默认把标记复用于无关图片。

ZIP每批最多50张，同时只能生成一个ZIP，并发请求可能包含相同图片。也可导出结果URL的CSV，但URL七天后失效，是临时交接列表而非永久存储。Clip/Re-clip与Download/Re-download区分处理及下载状态。上传带宽可能影响编辑，指南建议必要时等上传结束。本文未执行队列、ZIP或CSV。

sections.title_en: Download credits and viewed SGD plans
sections.title_zh: 下载点数及本次新币方案
sections.en:
The [price page](https://clippingmagic.com/pricing) was localized to SGD. Monthly Light lists 15 credits forSGD 4.74, Standard 100 for 9.49 and Pro 500 for 22.49, with larger tiers. Annual Light lists 180 credits/year billedSGD 47.40; Standard 1,200 for 94.80; Pro 6,000 for 224.88. Annual figures are annual allowances/totals, not a promise to replenish that many each month. Monthly unused-credit caps are 75/500/2,500 and annual caps 900/6,000/30,000 respectively. Standard and higher list Bulk Clipping; Light does not. API access is a separate offer.

One credit covers one image download, with repeated downloads/re-edits of that image counting only once. Uploading the same source twice creates separately counted images. Preview/editing alone does not authorize an unwatermarked free download. This workflow distinction can materially change a batch estimate. Currency selection, taxes, actual checkout and API rates were not tested.
sections.zh:
[价格页](https://clippingmagic.com/pricing)本次本地化为新币。月付Light为15点/SGD4.74、Standard100点/9.49、Pro500点/22.49，另有大档。年付Light为180点/年、扣SGD47.40；Standard1,200点/94.80；Pro6,000点/224.88。这是年度额度/总额，不表示每月补同样数量。三档月付未用上限为75/500/2,500，年付为900/6,000/30,000。Standard及以上列批量，Light未列；API独立。

1点覆盖1图下载，同图重编辑/重下载只计一次，同源重复上传则分别计。能预览/编辑不等于可免费无水印下载，这会影响批量预算。未测试币种选择、税费、实际结账或API价。

sections.title_en: Rollover is conditional on the subscription
sections.en:
The pricing page has no pay-as-you-go option; users can renew early when they need more credits, immediately charging and adding credits. Upgrades/renewals are immediate; a downgrade changes the next bill/credit cap without changing the billing date. Subscriptions auto-renew, are personal and cannot be shared, and fees are not refundable.

Cancellation preserves use through the paid period, but remaining credits are lost when cancellation takes effect. Rollover is capped, not unlimited banking. Before a large job, check the current credit balance, rollover cap and the plan that actually enables bulk. Keep downloaded results and original photos rather than relying on expiring URLs or assuming a canceled subscription preserves unused credits.
sections.zh:
价格页没有随用随付；需要更多点数可提前续订，立即扣费并加点。升级/续费立即生效，降级不改账单日，但下次账单和点数上限降低。订阅自动续费、仅个人使用不可共享，费用不退款。

取消后可用到已付账期末，但取消生效时剩余点数丢失。结转有上限，不是无限存点。大任务前应检查余额、结转上限及真正支持批量的套餐，保留下载结果和原图，不依赖到期URL或假定取消后点数仍在。

sections.title_en: Private uploads and shared result links have different scope
sections.title_zh: 私有上传与分享链接范围不同
sections.en:
The [terms](https://clippingmagic.com/policies/terms) distinguish private and partially public submissions. Private uploads grant an operational license needed to provide the service while retaining the user’s other rights. Choosing secret-link sharing gives holders access/usage rights within the service, so treat those links as access-bearing information. Uploaders must have appropriate rights; a successful cutout does not clear an image’s copyright or model permissions.

The same terms govern multiple service/assets and restrict AI/ML dataset/training/benchmark use of service content/results absent permission. They do not establish an open-source platform license or unlimited redistribution of provider assets. Exact retention/deletion, maximum input resolution and API-specific output/access conditions remain unverified. The tutorial’s embedded generic size-warning dialog is not used as a universal 4 MPcap. No product images, account, API request or quality/restore test was executed.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://clippingmagic.com/policies/terms)区分私有及部分公开提交。私有上传授予提供服务所需运营许可，保留用户其他权利；主动使用秘密链接分享会让持链接者在服务内访问/使用，因此这些链接承载访问权。上传者仍须有适当权限，抠图成功不清除版权或模特授权问题。

同一条款覆盖多种服务/素材，并在未获授权时限制将服务内容/结果用于AI/ML数据集、训练及基准，不构成平台开源或提供方素材无限再分发许可。具体保留/删除、最大输入分辨率及API专属输出/访问条件仍未核实。教程嵌入的通用尺寸警告弹窗不当作统一4MP上限。未执行商品图、账户、API或质量/恢复测试。
